reason: The cited evidence supports heterogeneous microstructures improving strength-ductility synergy (E3, E4) and coherent precipitates aiding ductility (E2), but no evidence is provided for cryo-rolling specifically, its effect on defect density, or any enhancement of Young's modulus and fracture resistance through this route.
premises: Cryo-rolling increases defect density and stored energy, accelerating heterogeneous precipitation during annealing
Annealing after cryo-rolling produces a hierarchical dual-phase microstructure with ultrafine grains and coherent nanoprecipitates
This hierarchical microstructure generates back-stress strengthening and favorable load partitioning
The refined grains and ductile precipitates delay crack initiation and propagation, improving fracture resistance
The microstructure stabilizes under load, enhancing Young's modulus
